mapper.select: SELECT u.USER_ID, u.NICKNAME, u.BUTTIE_TOTAL_EXP, u.BUTTIE_LEVEL, u.USERNAME, u.PHONE_NUMBER, u.EMAIL, ep.BIRTH_DATE FROM USER u JOIN EMPLOYMENT_PREPARATION ep ON u.USER_ID = ep.USER_ID WHERE u.USER_ID = #{userId}
